'''B-6NX''' was a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] had an experimental emotional programming that was supposed to enhance the cohesive action of units in battle and so when his [[Droid/Legends|droid]] comrade [[R-5TM]] was damaged it, B-6NX tried to help him instead of focusing on the mission. B-6NX asked a passing Imperial hero to retrieve necessary parts to fix R-5TM, while the droid itself refused help and insisted that B-6NX's compassion was a threat to the mission and had to be removed.<ref name="TORCIA:Reprogram" />
